recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future edits to valueset-unclosed definition text should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack or the later FHIR-40718/FHIR-49701 issue family, not by recreating the removed core extension source for FHIR-23700.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue asking to narrow valueset-unclosed so it SHALL only be used for post-coordinated or grammar-based code systems with no practical expansion, and to clarify that practical expansion limits are handled by offset and total.
initial_application: Core commit 4be2307113446802c0b34b84a74c39a4742ba9c1 applied the FHIR-23700 wording to the extension differential definition and comment, but left the top-level StructureDefinition.description with older text; later FHIR-40718 evidence called out that disconnect.
additional_context: Core commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed ValueSet extension definitions from core. The current authoritative valueset-unclosed StructureDefinition is in HL7/fhir-extensions, where FHIR-40718 deliberately revised both definition and description to allow technical limitations and require client opt-in. Current core still has ValueSet active and $expand operation references to the extension, but not the extension definition source targeted by this seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No FHIR-core source was changed because restoring or reintroducing the old FHIR-23700 extension text in core would conflict with the current source split and later applied Extension Pack wording.
